title: The keyboard manager always lose efficacy when use for a long time
author: abblank

status.label: Intermittent remap loss overlaps the existing Keyboard Manager tracker
status.detail: Long-running app-specific Alt remaps stop working and later recover; issue 48864 tracks the same inconsistent-remapping class, so a second agent design would duplicate unresolved evidence collection.

next_action.label: Consolidate with the remap-consistency issue
next_action.reason: Use the related tracker to collect a current failure capture and exact mapping.

judgment.rationale: The report is specific about intermittent duration and recovery but not about one deterministic trigger. The linked open issue covers inconsistent remapping, and neither thread has a concrete fix attempt yet.
evidence: PowerToys 0.100.1 and earlier versions are reported affected.
App-specific Alt+letter remaps initially work, fail after roughly ten minutes or longer, and may recover after minutes or hours.
Issue 48864 is open for inconsistent key remapping.
judgment.recommended_action: Avoid duplicate implementation work and consolidate exact mappings and failure diagnostics under the active Keyboard Manager consistency tracker.

fix_assessment.rationale: No issue-specific fix can be responsibly proposed before the intermittent failure is isolated, and the same problem class is already tracked in issue 48864.

issue_context.summary: Long-running app-specific Alt remaps stop working and later recover; issue 48864 tracks the same inconsistent-remapping class, so a second agent design would duplicate unresolved evidence collection.
known_information: The failure is limited to configured application-specific shortcuts.
Restarting or re-enabling does not always restore behavior.
A second user reports the same situation.
The existing request asks for numbered steps and Engine log errors.
inferences: A hook lifecycle, target-process identity, or remap-state transition may be involved, but the issue does not distinguish them.
issue_context.analysis: The related tracker is the appropriate place for a fresh current capture. This artifact records the overlap without presenting a speculative fix or duplicate request.
initial_investigation: Read the complete issue body, diagnostic reference, and both comments.
Checked issue 48864 and found it open with the same inconsistent-remapping theme.
Found no linked implementation PR or assignee.
